tools.name: search_business
tools.description: Find Jid business files by name or by any registry number (FEI, LEI, SEC CIK, DUNS, NDC labeler code, state licence or entity number). Returns candidate files with status and match evidence.

tools.name: get_business_file
tools.description: The full Jid file for one business: status, identifiers, every current fact with its source, verification date, next check and confidence, owner statements (labelled self-reported), possible matches and the change history.

tools.name: verify_business
tools.description: Check a business before an agent pays, signs, books, hires or buys. Pass the Jid id (or a name or registry number) and, to get a decision, the activity. Returns decision (proceed, review, stop or insufficient_data) with reasons: each names the requirement, met (true, false or unknown), the fact ids,

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Retrieve a stored, Ed25519-signed verification receipt by receipt_id: the inputs, decision, reasons, fact ids and value hashes, rules version and time. Use it to prove what was checked before an action. Free; not a check.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "screen" appears informational but accepts parameters (context) that enable code/file/secret access.

evidence.snippet: domain, url, email, phone, company_name, context, amount, policy, country, ip_country, ip_region, ip_asn, browser_timezone, stated_country, signal, site

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: verify_business, qualify_counterparty, screen, check_email · Private data: search_business, get_business_file, qualify_counterparty · Public sink: screen, check_email · Destructive: qualify_counterparty.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: verify_business, qualify_counterparty, screen, check_email · Private data: search_business, get_business_file, qualify_counterparty · Public sink: screen, check_email · Destructive: qualify_counterparty

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "qualify_counterparty" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
